VERSION 3.28.0.172

; Writerdeck native sidebar entry for rM2 software 3.28 (XOVI + qt-resource-rebuilder).
; Stock sidebar moved to FocusScope + ArkControls.SidebarItem (AppLoad PR 59/62).
; Do not mark 3.28 tested until the row appears and xochitl does not crash-loop.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Sidebar.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0

    TRAVERSE FocusScope > ColumnLayout#filterColumn
        LOCATE AFTER ArkControls.SidebarFoldout#integrationsFoldout
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.SidebarItem {
                id: openWriterdeck
                objectName: "openWriterdeck"
                text: qsTr("Writerdeck")
                iconSource: "qrc:/writerdeck/icon.png"
                enabled: true
                Layout.preferredHeight: Common.Values.navigatorSidebarItemHeight
                Layout.preferredWidth: parent.width

                CommandExecutor {
                    id: writerdeckCmd
                }

                onClicked: {
                    root.toggle();
                    writerdeckCmd.executeCommand("/bin/sh", [
                        "/home/root/writerdeck-sidebar-launch.sh"
                    ]);
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
